item.title: Version 0.18.2
item.description:
SupaSidebar 0.18.2

What’s New

  • Dark Mode: New appearance picker in the menu bar and Preferences > Appearance, with System, Light, and Dark options.

Bug Fixes

  • Locked tabs no longer get closed when you switch away from a different space.
  • Sidebar links matching a route now open in the configured profile (e.g. Safari Work) instead of the default one.
  • The Open Next button now respects route and profile rules, like a regular sidebar click.
  • Saving the current page when a route decides its destination no longer crashes the app.
